description: This file defines views related to data sources in the Superset application, including endpoints for saving, retrieving, and getting metadata about data sources, as well as handling sample data and dataset editing.

classes.name: Datasource
classes.description: Defines views for managing data sources, including saving, retrieving, and metadata operations.

classes.name: DatasetEditor
classes.description: Provides views for editing datasets, including adding and displaying datasets.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating a datasource based on posted data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a datasource's data by type and ID.

methods.name: external_metadata
methods.description: Fetches column info from the source system for a given datasource.

methods.name: external_metadata_by_name
methods.description: Gets table metadata from the source system and SQLAlchemy inspector using parameters.

methods.name: samples
methods.description: Provides sample data for a datasource, with access control for guests.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a specific dataset for editing or redirects.
